title: Yanhe Technology launches three perovskite solar module technologies into orbit
summary: Beijing-based Yanhe Technology has launched three perovskite-based photovoltaic modules into low Earth orbit to assess their performance under space conditions. The mission will test perovskite-silicon tandem, perovskite-CIGS tandem, and flexible single-junction perovskite technologies. The post Yanhe Technology launches three perovskite solar module technologies into orbit appeared first on pv magazine Global .
